concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-docs-guides-paypal-commerce-ios-setup]] - historical, unversioned PayPal Commerce iOS SDK setup snapshot for CocoaPods, Commerce Panel OAuth configuration, URL/app-delegate callbacks, optional platform integrations and store presentation; distinct from modular `braintree-ios` and its GitHub evidence, and not current enablement or payment proof
warnings: The source names no SDK release and contains legacy Objective-C, iOS 9+, 3D Touch and device references; keep the reciprocal route snapshot-scoped.
Do not transfer this PayPal Commerce SDK setup to the independently versioned modular Braintree iOS SDK or Drop-in.
Configuration calls and Commerce Panel steps do not prove current account eligibility, app enablement, store provisioning or payment execution.
